title: fix(ci): read transient jobs-API failures, re-run attempts and stale shards without false reds in the aggregate Test gate (objectui#13064)
body:
Fixes #13064

The aggregate `Test` gate (`scripts/check-test-shard-results.mjs`) went red three ways on 2026-10-19 with every shard green. This PR repairs all three in that one script. No workflow, required-check or settings edit; `ci.yml` is read, never edited.

## What changes

1. **A transient read is asked again, bounded and logged.** A 5xx, a connection that fails before any answer (`TypeError: fetch failed`, cause `ECONNRESET` measured), and a request past `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` (a `TimeoutError` measured) are retried at most `TRANSIENT_RETRY_LIMIT` times, `TRANSIENT_RETRY_WAIT_MS` apart, one log line each. A 5xx still standing after the last retry stays exit 2. 401, 403, 404, 429 and every other 4xx exit 2 at once. A truncated page exits 2 at once, because the body is parsed outside the retry; mid-body it rejects as `TypeError: terminated`, measured. A missing `GITHUB_TOKEN` exits 2 before any request. The header always claimed that last one, but until now the request simply went out without an `authorization` header. Every verdict is still taken from a 200 body.
2. **On `GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` above 1, a shard absent from the current attempt is judged by its latest earlier attempt.** Earlier attempts are read on their own `attempts/{k}/jobs` route, latest first, only while a shard is still absent. A carried record whose `run_attempt` disagrees with its route is refused. A shard in no attempt stays `ABSENT` and red. A carried `failure`, `cancelled` or `skipped` stays red. A shard the re-run re-ran is judged by its re-run. The own-job control stays on the current attempt, and nothing is carried into a reading that fails it.
3. **Staleness past the first re-read bound no longer ejects an all-green group on its own.** When `TEST_MATRIX_ROLLUP` reads `success` (ci.yml already hands `needs.test.result` to this step under that name) and the only disagreement after `REREAD_LIMIT` re-reads is present shards with no conclusion, the re-read continues `STALE_REREAD_LIMIT` more times, `STALE_REREAD_WAIT_MS` apart. The rollup only decides whether to wait longer. A pass still needs every shard's own `success`, and a `completed_at` without a conclusion is not one. Any other disagreement (a `failure`, an absent shard) ends the extension at once.

`main` is now `run(argv, deps)` over the real environment, network and clock, so the pins drive the same composition CI runs.

## Hypothesis 1, measured on run 39276047959 (attempts 1 and 2), REST, after the fact

| Route | Answer |
|---|---|
| `attempts/1/jobs` | 200, `total_count` 24, all `run_attempt` 1, 16 shards `success`, own job `Test` present (`failure`) |
| `attempts/2/jobs` | 200, `total_count` 24, all `run_attempt` 2, 16 shards `success`, own job `Test` present (`failure`) |
| `attempts/3/jobs` | 404 (the attempt does not exist) |
| `jobs?filter=all` | 200, `total_count` 48 = both attempts mixed, 24 duplicate names, attributable only by `run_attempt` |
| `jobs?filter=latest` | 200, `total_count` 24, attempt 2 only |
| `jobs` (no filter) | same as `filter=latest` |

Attempt 2 lists 24 jobs today, but when the gate read it, it listed only the re-run subset: the card's log shows 16 shards `ABSENT`. The carried-forward copies were materialized later. Each attempt-2 copy carries a job id above the attempt-2 `Test` job's id, and the two skipped coverage copies show a `started_at` of 15:41:56Z and 15:51:04Z, after that `Test` job finished at 15:35:11Z. Hence the per-attempt route. `filter=latest` is the current attempt alone, the very thing that was empty. `filter=all` would be keyed by a per-job field alone. The script header records why and keeps the own-job control.

Run 39286083342's job log (MCP `get_job_logs`, read once) is the item-3 measurement. At the first read (16:42:49Z), nine shards had no conclusion, three of them reading `queued`. Seven settled during the eight re-reads. `Test (shard 7/16)` and `Test (shard 12/16)` still read `in_progress` at 16:44:59Z, beside `TEST_MATRIX_ROLLUP: success`.

## Budgets and their bound

| Constant | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `REREAD_LIMIT` x `REREAD_WAIT_MS` | 8 x 15 s (unchanged) | the first re-read stretch, for every null shard |
| `STALE_REREAD_LIMIT` x `STALE_REREAD_WAIT_MS` | 9 x 30 s | both stretches together sleep 6 min 30 s, which covers the recorded 6 min 22 s even if it starts at the gate's own first read |
| `TRANSIENT_RETRY_LIMIT` x `TRANSIENT_RETRY_WAIT_MS` | 3 x 10 s | bounded retry of a transient read |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS` | 20 s | one request's own bound |
| `GATE_BUDGET_MS` | 7 min 30 s | hard wall for the whole gate step |

The bound is the `test-aggregate` job's `timeout-minutes: 10`. Every wait starts only if it and one more full request fit before `GATE_BUDGET_MS`, and each request's timeout is cut to what is left, so the gate step cannot outlive its job. Past that point the job would report `cancelled`, which the queue reads as a red. The remaining 2 min 30 s covers set-up, checkout and post steps (about 10 s in each of the three recorded runs) plus the report-only headroom step's single `fetchRunJobs()` read, which takes no retry and is bounded by `REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS`. Pinned: `GATE_BUDGET_MS + REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS + 2 min` is at most `timeout-minutes`, and both stretches together are at least the recorded staleness and fit inside the budget with one request.

## Pins added (26, in `scripts/__tests__/check-test-shard-results.test.ts`)

Transient read: `⭐ one 502 then 200 gives a verdict` · `⛔ a 5xx that persists past the bound stays exit 2` · `a connection reset and a request timeout are retried the same way` · `a re-read that meets a 5xx is asked again too` · `⛔ 401, 403, 404 and 429 are answers: exit 2 at once, never asked again` · `⛔ a truncated page is exit 2 at once, never asked again` · `⛔ a missing token is exit 2 before any request` · `⛔ no retry starts that the gate budget cannot finish`.

Re-run attempts: `⭐ attempt 2 with every shard only in attempt 1, all success, passes` · `⛔ attempt 2 with a shard failure in attempt 1 and not re-run stays red` · `⛔ a carried cancelled or skipped stays red` · `⛔ a shard present in no attempt stays ABSENT` · `a shard the re-run re-ran is judged by its re-run, both ways` · `takes each absent shard from the LATEST earlier attempt that has it, and stops reading once none is absent` · `⛔ the own-job control is the current attempt's, and nothing is carried into a reading that fails it` · `refuses a carried record whose run_attempt is not the attempt it was read from` · `⛔ an earlier attempt that cannot be read is exit 2, never a pass`.

Staleness: `⭐ shards still in_progress past the first bound settle inside the extension while the rollup reads success` · `⛔ without a success rollup the same answer stays red after the first bound` · `⛔ the rollup never passes a shard: one that never answers stays red, completed_at and all` · `⛔ no extension once anything but a missing conclusion disagrees` · `⛔ no re-read starts that the gate budget cannot finish` · `run reads the rollup from TEST_MATRIX_ROLLUP, the name ci.yml hands it in under`.

ci.yml wiring: `keeps the whole gate inside the job, with room for the steps around it` · `sizes the two re-read stretches against the recorded staleness and the gate budget` · `hands the gate the matrix rollup under the name it reads`.

No network in tests: a scripted `fetchImpl` and a virtual clock that only `sleep` moves.

## Ablation (one behaviour reverted at a time, then restored; implementation committed first)

Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. Each one landed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob changed). Each restore was proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

| Behaviour | Mutation | Red leg | Green leg |
|---|---|---|---|
| transient retry | `if (retry >= retries)` to `if (retry >= 0)` | exit 1, 5 failed, 48 passed | exit 0, 53 passed |
| carry from earlier attempts | `k >= 1` to `k >= current` | exit 1, 5 failed, 48 passed | exit 0, 53 passed |
| stale-API extension | `rollup === 'success'` to `rollup === 'ablated'` | exit 1, 4 failed, 49 passed | exit 0, 53 passed |

Every red leg failed exactly the pins of its own behaviour, and nothing else.

## Local gates (final head `90cbaeb`)

- `pnpm test scripts/__tests__/check-test-shard-results.test.ts scripts/__tests__/shard-headroom.test.ts scripts/__tests__/test-file-timings.test.ts` → exit 0, 3 files, 78 passed. The other two files are the ones that name this script or its importer `shard-headroom.mjs`.
- `pnpm run type-check:scripts` (`tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json`) → exit 0. `--listFiles` confirms both changed files are in the program.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on both files → exit 0.
- `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:entry-guard`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:pre-install-import-graph` → exit 0 each.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths → exit 0, NOT GOVERNED.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` → exit 0, no changeset owed. The precedents objectui#13031 and objectui#13035 for tooling-only `scripts/` changes carry none either.
- The full farm is this PR's CI.

Rollback: revert the squash commit. Nothing outside the two files moves.

## Acceptance notes

- `ci.yml`'s comment on `TEST_MATRIX_ROLLUP` ("Printed, never trusted") and the step's echo ("deliberately does NOT trust") are still true for the verdict. The gate now also reads the rollup to decide whether to wait longer. `ci.yml` is governed and outside this claim, so it is left alone. Carrier: none.
- `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` describes the gate without the retry, the attempt carry or the extension. Nothing it says became false, so it is left alone. Carrier: none.
- `scripts/shard-headroom.mjs` (report-only) shares `fetchRunJobs()`. It keeps its single attempt but is now bounded by the 20 s request timeout; before, it had none of its own. On a re-run attempt it still reads only the current attempt and prints NOT MEASURED. That is an observation, not a gate. Carrier: none.
